rules.title: ESXi build is not exposed to known security advisories
rules.rationale: Hosts below the fixed build of a published advisory remain exposed to its vulnerabilities, some of which are exploited in the wild.

mitigation.summary: Patch the host to the fixed build listed for each advisory.
steps: Stage the patch or image in vSphere Lifecycle Manager
Evacuate the host (maintenance mode) and remediate

rules.limitations: Evaluates the embedded advisory snapshot only; OEM custom images and express patches may differ.

rules.title: ESXi release is within vendor general support
rules.rationale: Releases past end of general support stop receiving routine security fixes.

mitigation.summary: Plan an upgrade to a supported ESXi release.

rules.title: Host image acceptance level is not CommunitySupported
rules.rationale: CommunitySupported VIBs are unsigned and bypass vendor validation, enabling malicious kernel modules.

mitigation.summary: Set the acceptance level to PartnerSupported or higher and remove community VIBs.

rules.title: Only installed binaries may execute (execInstalledOnly)
rules.rationale: Blocks execution of binaries not delivered through a signed VIB, a common ransomware technique on ESXi.

mitigation.summary: Enable execInstalledOnly (and enforcement on 8.0 U2+).
steps: esxcli system settings kernel set -s execInstalledOnly -v TRUE (review first)

rules.title: TPM attestation of host boot is accepted
rules.rationale: TPM 2.0 attestation provides evidence that the host booted with Secure Boot and trusted components.

mitigation.summary: Enable UEFI Secure Boot and TPM 2.0 in firmware; investigate attestation failures.
steps: Enable TPM 2.0 (FIFO/CRB) and Secure Boot in BIOS

rules.title: SSH service is stopped and set to start manually
rules.rationale: Persistent SSH exposes a privileged remote shell and bypasses vCenter auditing.

mitigation.summary: Stop SSH and set its startup policy to manual.
steps: Host > Configure > Services > SSH > Stop; Startup policy: Start and stop manually

rules.title: ESXi Shell is stopped and set to start manually
rules.rationale: The ESXi Shell grants unaudited root-level access on the console.

mitigation.summary: Stop the ESXi Shell service and set it to manual.
steps: Host > Configure > Services > ESXi Shell > Stop

rules.title: SLP service is stopped and disabled
rules.rationale: OpenSLP has been exploited at scale for ESXi ransomware (e.g. CVE-2021-21974).

mitigation.summary: Stop slpd, set it to manual and disable the CIMSLP firewall ruleset.
steps: /etc/init.d/slpd stop; esxcli network firewall ruleset set -r CIMSLP -e 0; chkconfig slpd off (review first)

rules.title: CIM server is not running unless required
rules.rationale: CIM exposes hardware management interfaces; limit it to hosts that need hardware monitoring.

mitigation.summary: Disable CIM where hardware monitoring does not require it, or record an exception.
steps: esxcli system wbem set --enable false (review first)

rules.title: SNMP agent is not running unless required
rules.rationale: SNMP v1/v2c community strings are cleartext; use SNMPv3 only when monitoring requires it.

mitigation.summary: Disable SNMP or configure SNMPv3 with authentication and privacy, then record an exception.
steps: esxcli system snmp get / set (review first)

rules.title: Lockdown mode is enabled
rules.rationale: Lockdown mode forces management through vCenter so access is centrally authorized and audited.

mitigation.summary: Enable normal lockdown mode (strict for the strict profile) and define exception users.
steps: Host > Configure > Security Profile > Lockdown Mode > Edit

rules.limitations: Uses HostConfigInfo.lockdownMode; the deprecated adminDisabled Boolean is not used.

rules.title: DCUI idle timeout is 600 seconds or less
rules.rationale: Idle console sessions can be reused by anyone with physical or remote console access.

mitigation.summary: Set UserVars.DcuiTimeOut to 600 or less.

rules.title: ESXi Shell and SSH services time out within an hour
rules.rationale: Automatically disables shell services that were enabled temporarily and forgotten.

mitigation.summary: Set UserVars.ESXiShellTimeOut (e.g. 600).

rules.title: Idle ESXi Shell and SSH sessions time out after 300 seconds or less
rules.rationale: Terminates abandoned interactive root sessions.

mitigation.summary: Set UserVars.ESXiShellInteractiveTimeOut to 300 or less.

rules.title: Host Client session timeout is 900 seconds or less
rules.rationale: Limits reuse of unattended browser sessions to the host client.

mitigation.summary: Set UserVars.HostClientSessionTimeout to 900 or less.

rules.title: Failed login attempts before lockout is 5 or fewer
rules.rationale: Limits online password guessing against local accounts.

mitigation.summary: Set Security.AccountLockFailures to 5.

rules.title: Account lockout lasts at least 15 minutes
rules.rationale: Short lockouts do not meaningfully slow password guessing.

mitigation.summary: Set Security.AccountUnlockTime to 900.

rules.title: Password quality control enforces long passwords
rules.rationale: Short local passwords are practical to brute force offline and online.

mitigation.summary: Set Security.PasswordQualityControl, e.g. 'retry=3 min=disabled,disabled,disabled,disabled,15'.

rules.title: Previous 5 passwords cannot be reused
rules.rationale: Prevents cycling back to compromised passwords.

mitigation.summary: Set Security.PasswordHistory to 5 or more.

rules.title: AD admin group is not the default 'ESX Admins'
rules.rationale: Any domain user able to create an 'ESX Admins' group gains full host admin rights on AD-joined hosts (CVE-2024-37085, exploited by ransomware operators).

mitigation.summary: Set esxAdminsGroup to a dedicated, protected group (or empty if AD is not used) and disable auto-add.

rules.title: AD admin group auto-add is disabled
rules.rationale: Automatic admin grant for a named AD group is the root cause of CVE-2024-37085.

mitigation.summary: Set esxAdminsGroupAutoAdd to false.

rules.title: Managed Object Browser is disabled
rules.rationale: The MOB exposes the host API through a browser and can be used to change configuration.

mitigation.summary: Set Config.HostAgent.plugins.solo.enableMob to false.

rules.title: dvfilter network API is not bound
rules.rationale: A bound dvfilter API lets a VM inspect traffic of other VMs if abused.

mitigation.summary: Clear Net.DVFilterBindIpAddress unless a security appliance requires it.
steps: Set advanced setting Net.DVFilterBindIpAddress to empty

rules.title: Guest BPDU frames are blocked
rules.rationale: Prevents a VM from triggering BPDU guard on upstream switches (denial of service).

mitigation.summary: Set Net.BlockGuestBPDU to 1.

rules.title: Transparent page sharing uses per-VM salting
rules.rationale: Inter-VM page sharing can enable side-channel attacks.

mitigation.summary: Set Mem.ShareForceSalting to 2.

rules.title: Shell warnings are not suppressed
rules.rationale: The warning makes enabled shell services visible to operators.

mitigation.summary: Set UserVars.SuppressShellWarning to 0.

rules.title: Host agent log level is info
rules.rationale: Adequate log detail is needed for investigations without excessive volume.

mitigation.summary: Set Config.HostAgent.log.level to info.

rules.title: Time synchronization is configured and running
rules.rationale: Accurate time is required for log correlation, certificates and Kerberos.

mitigation.summary: Configure authoritative NTP/PTP sources and start the service with policy 'on'.

rules.title: Remote syslog is configured
rules.rationale: Local logs can be erased by an attacker with root access; remote copies preserve evidence.

mitigation.summary: Set Syslog.global.logHost to the authorized collector(s) and open the syslog firewall ruleset.
steps: Set advanced setting Syslog.global.logHost = udp://collector:514 (use tls:// where supported)

rules.title: Logs are stored persistently
rules.rationale: Logs on ramdisk are lost at reboot.

mitigation.summary: Point Syslog.global.logDir to a persistent datastore location.

rules.limitations: Cannot confirm the default scratch location is backed by persistent storage.

rules.title: Core dumps are sent to a central collector
rules.rationale: Core dumps can contain secrets and support forensic analysis; central collection controls both.

mitigation.summary: Configure network core dump to a secured collector.
steps: esxcli system coredump network set / set --enable true (review first)

rules.title: Host firewall blocks incoming traffic by default
rules.rationale: A permissive default exposes every listening service.

mitigation.summary: Restore the default block policy for incoming traffic.
steps: esxcli network firewall set --default-action false (review first)

rules.title: Management services restrict allowed source IPs
rules.rationale: Restricting management services to admin networks reduces reachable attack surface.

mitigation.summary: Limit allowed IPs of management rulesets to management networks.
steps: Host > Configure > Firewall > Edit > Allowed IP addresses

rules.title: Host certificate is not self-signed
rules.rationale: Self-signed certificates train operators to accept certificate warnings and enable interception.

mitigation.summary: Issue host certificates from VMCA or the enterprise CA.

rules.title: Host certificate is not expired or near expiry
rules.rationale: Expired certificates break trust validation and encourage insecure workarounds.

mitigation.summary: Renew the host certificate.

rules.title: iSCSI adapters require mutual CHAP
rules.rationale: Without mutual CHAP, initiators and targets can be impersonated.

mitigation.summary: Configure required unidirectional and mutual CHAP with unique secrets.

rules.title: Management traffic is separated from vMotion and storage
rules.rationale: vMotion and storage traffic is unencrypted by default and should not share the management interface.

mitigation.summary: Use dedicated VMkernel adapters (and TCP/IP stacks) for vMotion and storage.

rules.title: DCUI access and lockdown exception users are reviewed

check.guidance: Confirm DCUI.Access and exception users contain only approved break-glass accounts

rules.rationale: Users in DCUI.Access and the exception list bypass lockdown mode.

mitigation.summary: Limit DCUI.Access and exception users to approved accounts.

rules.title: Local accounts are named, least-privilege and reviewed

check.guidance: Review local ESXi accounts, roles and SSH authorized_keys; prefer directory-backed named admins

rules.rationale: Shared root use prevents accountability; stray authorized keys allow persistent access.

mitigation.summary: Use named accounts, remove unused local users and empty /etc/ssh/keys-root/authorized_keys.
steps: Review Host > Permissions and local users
